note: The independent 2005 Compendium and 1952 Enchiridion witnesses agree on all 64 substantive words, their order and the complete prayer boundary. Their differences are confined to accents, ae/æ typography, lineation, dashes and sentence punctuation handled by substantive-only comparison. The 1910 Raccolta and 1906 Lasance bilingual pages independently confirm the same complete Latin recension. The corpus normalizes meae and saecula to house æ typography and uses sense-based segment stops without changing syntax.
